description: A rectangle whose pixels a client program draws with its own renderer (ActionUIHostSurface add-on). The client binds to it by surfaceName through the add-on's C or Swift API and gets the native surface (a CAMetalLayer on macOS and iOS; on Linux it presents frames to a frame sink), its size and scale, frame ticks and input. No observable value.

surfaceName.description: Binds the element to the client registered under this name. Fixed at load

kind.description: native (default): the platform's surface, a CAMetalLayer on macOS and iOS, a frame sink on Linux. sink: a frame sink on every platform (the client presents pixels). gl: a GL area the client draws in from its render callback (Linux). A kind the platform lacks draws a placeholder. Fixed at load

continuous.description: A frame callback at every display refresh while on screen; default false (one per requestFrame)

preferredFrameRate.description: Frames per second hint; default 0, the display rate

focusable.description: A click or tap gives the surface keyboard focus; default true. It never takes focus unasked

opaque.description: Default true. false lets content behind the element show through transparent pixels the client draws

composited.description: Android only: a TextureView instead of a SurfaceView, which honors opacity but is not paced by the display. Fixed at load. Ignored elsewhere

idealWidth.description: Natural width in points, used where the parent leaves the width unspecified; default 320

idealHeight.description: Natural height in points, used where the parent leaves the height unspecified; default 240

states.size.description: Surface size as [width, height] in points; updated when the surface size changes
